d:
Chhath mahaparv, aastha, shraddha, pavitrata aur prakriti ke prati kritagyata ka aisa parv, jismen bhagvan sury ki upasna ke sath jivan ke gahre sandesh bhi chhipe hain. char dinon tak chalne vale is mahaparv men har anushthan ka apna alag mahatv hai. nahay-khay se shuru hokar kharna, sandhya arghy aur phir usha arghy tak chalne vali puja men sabse khas hota hai.
